text: Entry Requirements 1) Non-Chinese citizens aged 18 and above (by September 1, 2020) holding a valid foreign ordinary passport; 2) For former Chinese citizens who have become foreign nationals, follow Notice by the Ministry of Education of Regulating Admission of International Students in China's Higher Education Institutions (JWH [2020] No. 12); 3) Must be a senior high school graduate or have the same educational level with good grades; 4) Must abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the rules and regulations of Chengdu University; 5) Must be in good health. 6) HSK (Level IV) Certificate obtained within two years.
